title: Order Flow Intuition
hook: You don’t need more data if you can’t read the price in front of you.

launchpad.outcome: Build order-flow intuition from candles, and ask questions the chart can actually answer.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Do you need a footprint chart to read participation?

slides.title: There’s a whole world of order-flow tools.
slides.prompt: Tap each one. Then set it aside.

cards.title: DOM / order book
cards.body: Shows resting orders at each price. Changes constantly. Set aside for now.

cards.title: Footprint charts
cards.body: Shows trading inside each candle. Powerful, and a lot. Set aside for now.

cards.title: Volume profile
cards.body: Shows where most trading happened. Set aside for now.

cards.title: Delta
cards.body: Compares aggressive buying and selling. Set aside for now.

slides.footer:
YOU DON’T NEED ALL OF THIS YET.
You can build real intuition from the price in front of you.

slides.heading: Questions price can answer.
slides.body:
• Where did price close?
  • Did it hold beyond the level, or come back?
  • How fast did it move? Big candles or small?
  • Did candles overlap, or travel cleanly?
  • Did the move change the structure?
That’s order-flow intuition, read straight from candles.

steps.text: Price poked above the prior high, then pulled back.

asks.prompt: PRICE INTERROGATION: which question is most useful to ask this chart?

options.label: Did price close back below the level, and is it holding there?
options.why: A question the chart can actually answer.

options.label: How many buy orders were filled up there?
options.feedback: The chart can’t show that number.

slides.quote: You don’t need more data if you still can’t read the price in front of you.

slides.prompt: What does order-flow intuition mean at this stage?
slides.modelAnswer: Reading what candles already show: where price closed, whether it held, how fast it moved, whether it overlapped, and whether structure changed. I don’t need extra tools yet. I need to ask price questions it can answer.

takeaways: Order-flow tools exist. You don’t need them yet.
Candles already answer: close, hold, speed, overlap, structure.
Ask the chart questions it can answer.
remember: You don’t need more data if you still can’t read the price in front of you.
